parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `DebugMetricsProvider` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` — carries `is_sample_app: true`. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a sample-app-marked record must be treated as intentional duplication: lifting the production `DebugPanel` type into shared code would couple production semantics to a demonstration fixture. The sample-app copy is a self-contained debug HUD living under `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/`, which is the canonical location for standalone demonstration code that intentionally mirrors production shapes. The only structural difference between the two records (`metalDevice:MTLDevice?` vs `metalDevice:(any MTLDevice)?`) is a minor existential-syntax variant, not evidence of a shared abstraction worth extracting.
